punchline: Feynman got his love of physics back by working out why a plate wobbles when it is tossed in a cafeteria.
thirty_sec: Burned out at Cornell, Feynman decided to play with physics again. In the cafeteria a plate wobbled through the air with a medallion turning on it. He worked out the equations for fun, told a colleague it had no importance, and the thinking led to the electron work that won him the Nobel.
